text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 你好，欢迎收听《简易英语》。
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽《簡易英語》。

text: In this podcast, we have real conversations.
zh: 在这个播客中，我们有真实的对话。
zh_hant: 在這個播客中，我們有真實的對話。

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简易英语来帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡易英語來幫助你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Beth.
You can find a video of this podcast
zh: 你可以找到这个播客的视频
zh_hant: 你可以找到這個播客的影片

text: and a worksheet to help you learn on our website,
zh: 和帮助你学习的工作表，在我们的网站上，
zh_hant: 和幫助你學習的工作表，在我們的網站上，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Beth, how are you today?
I'm good, thank you.
I am very busy.
I have a lot of meetings.
How are you?
I'm okay, thank you, Beth.
I don't have many meetings today,
but today we are talking about meetings,
zh: 但今天我们要谈论会议，
zh_hant: 但今天我們要談論會議，

text: in particular work meetings, where you talk to colleagues
zh: 特别是工作会议，你和同事交谈
zh_hant: 特別是工作會議，你和同事交談

text: and discuss ideas or make decisions.
That's right.
Okay, shall we get started?
Yes.
So, Beth, you have a lot of meetings today.
zh: 那么，贝丝，你今天有很多会议。
zh_hant: 那麼，貝絲，你今天有很多會議。

text: Do you generally have a lot of meetings at work?
zh: 你通常工作中会议很多吗？
zh_hant: 你通常工作中會議很多嗎？

text: It really depends on what I'm working on.
zh: 真的取决于我在做什么。
zh_hant: 真的取決於我在做什麼。

text: So if I have a project
where I need to meet a lot of people,
then I might have quite a few meetings.
zh: 那我可能会有不少会议。
zh_hant: 那我可能會有不少會議。

text: And that's why I'm busy now.
zh: 这也是我现在忙的原因。
zh_hant: 這也是我現在忙的原因。

text: But generally,
we have a few meetings together
zh: 我们团队会一起开几个会，
zh_hant: 我們團隊會一起開幾個會，

text: as a team,
but I don't think we have loads of meetings.
zh: 但我觉得我们会议不算多。
zh_hant: 但我覺得我們會議不算多。

text: Compared to other jobs, I don't think we have many meetings.
zh: 和其他工作相比，我觉得我们的会议不多。
zh_hant: 和其他工作相比，我覺得我們的會議不多。

text: Most of our work is producing things
zh: 我们大部分工作是制作内容
zh_hant: 我們大部分工作是製作內容

text: and editing and writing.
But you're right, when there are lots of big projects
zh: 但你说得对，当有很多大项目时，
zh_hant: 但你說得對，當有很多大專案時，

text: that we need to talk to other people on the project,
zh: 我们需要和项目中的其他人交流，
zh_hant: 我們需要和專案中的其他人交流，

text: we have more meetings.
But yeah, like you, it really depends.
zh: 但是啊，像你一样，真的要看情况。
zh_hant: 但是啊，像你一樣，真的要看情況。

text: So when do you think meetings are useful?
zh: 那你觉得什么时候会议是有用的？
zh_hant: 那你覺得什麼時候會議是有用的？

text: I think when you
need to brainstorm,
so brainstorm is when you have lots of new
zh: 头脑风暴就是当你有很多新的
zh_hant: 頭腦風暴就是當你有很多新的

text: ideas
and you need to talk about them together, I think
then meetings are really useful.
zh: 那时候会议真的很有用。
zh_hant: 那時候會議真的很有用。

text: Because you hear lots of new ideas,
zh: 因为你能听到很多新想法，
zh_hant: 因為你能聽到很多新想法，

text: and when you're in a room with other people,
zh: 而且当你在房间里和其他人在一起时，
zh_hant: 而且當你在房間裡和其他人在一起時，

text: if, for example, I have an idea and you say, that's good,
zh: 比如，如果我有个想法，你说很好，
zh_hant: 比如，如果我有個想法，你說很好，

text: and we can also do this and we can all
zh: 我们还可以这样做，我们可以一起
zh_hant: 我們還可以這樣做，我們可以一起

text: work together,
and I think those kind of meetings are really useful.
zh: 我觉得那种会议真的很有用。
zh_hant: 我覺得那種會議真的很有用。

text: Yeah, I think that way of doing it is also
zh: 是的，我觉得那种方式也更
zh_hant: 是的，我覺得那種方式也更

text: more efficient.
So sometimes it's better to just have one hour,
zh: 所以有时候最好只花一个小时，
zh_hant: 所以有時候最好只花一個小時，

text: come up with ideas and decide on the ideas.
Yeah, definitely.
Do you tend to speak up in meetings?
zh: 你在会议上通常会发言吗？
zh_hant: 你在會議上通常會發言嗎？

text: So that means do you ask questions
and feel confident to speak?
I think if the meeting
has lots of people,
I find it a bit more stressful to speak up
zh: 我会觉得发言有点压力
zh_hant: 我會覺得發言有點壓力

text: because I get a bit nervous to speak in front of lots of people,
zh: 因为在很多人面前讲话我会有点紧张，
zh_hant: 因為在很多人面前講話我會有點緊張，

text: but if it's a meeting with just our team,
zh: 但如果只是我们团队的会议，
zh_hant: 但如果只是我們團隊的會議，

text: for example you guys I like and trust,
zh: 比如你们这些我喜欢和信任的人，
zh_hant: 比如你們這些我喜歡和信任的人，

text: I don't mind speaking up that much.
And sometimes we have meetings
in person,
sometimes you have meetings on a call, so a video call.
zh: 有时候你在电话上开会，就是视频通话。
zh_hant: 有時候你在電話上開會，就是視訊通話。

text: Do you prefer meeting in person
or having calls?
I think I prefer meetings
zh: 我觉得我更喜欢面对面
zh_hant: 我覺得我更喜歡面對面

text: in person because you can kind of see
zh: 会议，因为你能更容易地看到
zh_hant: 會議，因為你能更容易地看到

text: the facial expressions and body language more easily,
I think, and it's easier to know
when a person wants to speak, these kinds of things.
zh: 一个人什么时候想说话之类的。
zh_hant: 一個人什麼時候想說話之類的。

text: Yeah, no, I agree with what you're saying.
A lot of the meetings that I have had recently
have been with people in different time zones
zh: 都是和在不同时区的人
zh_hant: 都是和在不同時區的人

text: in different countries.
So definitely then a call
is better
because it's the best way to speak
zh: 因为这是最好的讲话方式
zh_hant: 因為這是最好的講話方式

text: without having to go to different countries.
But I agree,
I think it's
nice to be able to see body language
better
in a face to face meeting.
But meetings on calls now are so normal,
zh: 但现在电话会议太常见了，
zh_hant: 但現在電話會議太常見了，

text: that there's not loads of difference.
It is also really nice to be able
to take calls in your own house.
So working from home can be really nice
zh: 所以在家工作可以很好
zh_hant: 所以在家工作可以很好

text: because you can have your snacks and drinks nearby.
zh: 因为你附近可以有零食和饮料。
zh_hant: 因為你附近可以有零食和飲料。

text: So yeah, they both have their pros and cons.
zh: 所以是的，两者各有优缺点。
zh_hant: 所以是的，兩者各有優缺點。

text: That's true.
Okay, let's recap the language we heard during the conversation,
zh: 好的，让我们回顾一下对话中听到的词汇，
zh_hant: 好的，讓我們回顧一下對話中聽到的詞彙，

text: starting with brainstorm, which is when you get together
zh: 从“头脑风暴”开始，就是你和一群
zh_hant: 從“頭腦風暴”開始，就是你和一群

text: with a group of people to come up with ideas.
If you speak up in a meeting,
you express your opinion using your voice.
zh: 你就是用声音表达你的意见。
zh_hant: 你就是用聲音表達你的意見。

text: In an in-person meeting,
everyone is in the same physical place.
zh: 每个人都在同一个实际地点。
zh_hant: 每個人都在同一個實際地點。

text: We can also call this a face-to-face meeting.
zh: 我们也可以叫它面对面会议。
zh_hant: 我們也可以叫它面對面會議。

text: And we also talked about having a call.
This could be a phone call or a video call.
zh: 这可以是电话或视频通话。
zh_hant: 這可以是電話或視訊通話。

text: And we can also describe this as a remote meeting.
zh: 我们也可以描述为远程会议。
zh_hant: 我們也可以描述為遠端會議。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《简易英语》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《簡易英語》的全部內容。

text: Why not test what you've learned using the worksheet on our website,
zh: 为什么不试试用我们网站上的工作表来测试你学到的内容呢？
zh_hant: 為什麼不試試用我們網站上的工作表來測試你學到的內容呢？

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
And we'll be back next week with another conversation
zh: 我们下周会再回来，带来另一个对话
zh_hant: 我們下週會再回來，帶來另一個對話

text: in Easy English.
See you then.
Goodbye.
